relations.text: Axcelisは、Veeco Instruments Inc.との合併契約を2025年9月30日に結んだ
relations.text_en: Axcelis entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger with Veeco Instruments Inc. on September 30, 2025

source.label: Axcelis 10-K
source.quote: On September 30, 2025, the Company, Victory Merger Sub, Inc., a Delaware corporation and a wholly-owned subsidiary of the Company (“Merger Sub”), and Veeco Instruments Inc., a Delaware corporation (“Veeco”), entered into an Agreement and Plan of Merger (the “Merger Agreement”).
source.note: 年次報告時点の合併契約の記載で、完了を示すものではありません。
source.note_en: Describes the signed merger agreement as of the annual report; completion is not stated.

relations.text: Axcelisは、日本市場向けにPurionの販売・サポートで、SCREEN Semiconductor Solutionsと戦略的契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Axcelis entered into a strategic agreement for distribution and support with SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions to bring the Purion platform to the Japanese market

source.label: Axcelis 2018年第1四半期の決算発表
source.quote: During the quarter, we entered into a strategic agreement for distribution and support with SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions to bring the Purion platform to the Japanese market.
source.note: 子会社のSCREEN Semiconductor Solutionsとの契約で、2018年の発表です。
source.note_en: Agreement with subsidiary SCREEN Semiconductor Solutions, announced in 2018.
